brief: A data request that normally takes a week. She needs it done today.
brief_id: Data request yang biasanya seminggu. Dia butuhnya hari ini.

scenes.text:
Priya's situation:
• 3 datasets to combine — customers, orders, support tickets
• Normal engineering request: 1-week turnaround
• Deadline: today
• Goal: find out why revenue is slipping

id.text:
Situasi Priya:
• 3 dataset yang perlu digabungkan — pelanggan, pesanan, tiket support
• Request ke engineering biasanya: 1 minggu
• Deadline: hari ini
• Tujuan: cari tahu kenapa pendapatan turun

scenes.text: Normally I'd submit a data request to the engineering team. One week turnaround. I don't have a week.

id.text: Biasanya saya submit data request ke tim engineering. Satu minggu prosesnya. Saya nggak punya waktu seminggu.

scenes.text: I need to cross-reference customers whose spending is declining with their support ticket history. If service issues are driving churn — I need to know now.

id.text: Saya perlu cross-reference pelanggan yang pengeluarannya turun dengan riwayat tiket support mereka. Kalau masalah layanan yang bikin mereka pergi — saya harus tahu sekarang.

scenes.text: You don't need to wait for engineering. Bob can pull and combine all three sources directly.

id.text: Kamu nggak perlu nunggu engineering. Bob bisa tarik dan gabungkan ketiga sumber data itu langsung.

scenes.problem: Combine customer info, orders, and support tickets to identify declining spenders — and find out if service issues are the cause.

id.problem: Gabungkan data pelanggan, pesanan, dan tiket support untuk identifikasi pelanggan yang pengeluarannya turun — dan cari tahu apakah masalah layanan yang jadi penyebabnya.

options.label: Ask Bob to run the data request
options.outcome: Data request complete. Declining customers identified. Service correlation visible. ✓

id_text.label: Minta Bob jalankan data request
id_text.outcome: Data request selesai. Pelanggan yang menurun teridentifikasi. Korelasi layanan terlihat. ✓

scenes.text: This would have taken a week through the normal process. I have the answer in minutes.

id.text: Ini biasanya seminggu lewat proses normal. Saya dapat jawabannya dalam menit.

scenes.text: Now you can act on the insight — not wait for the data.

id.text: Sekarang kamu bisa bertindak berdasarkan insight-nya — bukan nunggu datanya.

scenes.text:
Three datasets. One request. Answers in minutes.

The bottleneck was never the data — it was the wait. That's gone now.

id.text:
Tiga dataset. Satu request. Jawaban dalam menit.

Bottleneck-nya bukan datanya — tapi nunggu prosesnya. Sekarang sudah tidak ada lagi.
